review.evidence: The exact Ethereum token owner, proxy implementation, ProxyAdmin and its owner were re-read at block 26197399 (2026-10-15T10:44:59Z) with all six current signers and matching token, admin and wallet runtime bytes. The issuer wallet controls uncapped owner-only minting, burning, holder blocking, blocked-fund destruction, ownership replacement and immediate upgrades; no other native minter role exists in the reviewed implementation. The wallet remains the shared legacy controller already reviewed for USDT/XAUT; the exact MXNT owner and runtime were independently refreshed here, not inferred from those siblings. Quarterly BDO ISAE 3000R reasonable-assurance reports reconcile Tether International, S.A. de C.V.'s shared fiat-token reserve assets against its aggregate token and other liabilities. The latest retrieved period is June 30, 2026, signed July 31; daily circulation telemetry does not refresh financial assurance. MXNT has no separately allocated reserve mix or custody roster. CNAD's rendered stablecoin issuer registry re-opened on October 15, 2026 names the same legal issuer as EME-0003, registered May 19, 2025; current holder terms and the February 20, 2026 Relevant Information Document explicitly place MXNT in its issuance scope. This supports the existing Salvadoran prudential-supervision classification, not U.S. GENIUS authorization or an assurance opinion on CNAD status. BDO excludes report Notes from its engagement. Primary redemption requires a verified eligible customer, a USD 100,000-equivalent minimum and the greater of USD 1,000 or 0.1% fee; executable capacity and an unconditional settlement deadline are not published. Signer independence, key-custody/HSM policy and operational hold periods remain undisclosed. The issuer now lists Tron MXNT under deprecated protocols and publishes zero Tron token circulation; it is not admitted as an active deployment, and no historical-state or local-control closure is asserted for it. Polygon was named in the 2022 launch announcement but no current official deployment address was located. CoinGecko's stored historical slug returned HTTP 404 on October 15, 2026, so no geckoId is authored; the exact-contract CoinGecko read was rate-limited and does not establish a replacement identity.
